title: Soft tissue healing outcomes in dentistry with acellular dermal collagen matrix
authors: Frosecchi M, De Angelis N . Int. J. Dent. Biomat. Res. Mar 2022;1:28 -36.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of mucoderm® led to successful soft tissue treatment in various defects” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
